title: Sports
descriptionFa: اسم ورزش‌ها، اینکه با کدوم play یا go یا do می‌گیم، و جاهای ورزش.

words.example: My brothers play football in the park every Friday.
words.tipFa: بازی‌های توپی رو با play می‌گیم: play football. آمریکایی‌ها به فوتبال soccer می‌گن.

words.example: American football players wear helmets.
Rugby is very popular in New Zealand.
He's very tall, so he's good at basketball.
Iran has a strong volleyball team.
Do you want to play tennis on Saturday?
There's a table tennis table in our school.
We play badminton in the garden in summer.
Baseball is very popular in Japan and the USA.
I go swimming twice a week.
words.tipFa: ورزش‌های ing دار رو با go می‌گیم: go swimming, go running.

words.example: Running in the morning helps me wake up.
We went sailing on the lake last summer.
We tried kayaking on the river.
We go skiing at Shemshak every winter.
My cousin prefers snowboarding to skiing.
Formula One is the most famous kind of motor racing.
Horse racing is popular in Gonbad-e Kavus.
My daughter does judo after school.
words.tipFa: جودو و کاراته رو با do می‌گیم: do judo, do karate.

words.example: He has a black belt in karate.
The tennis court is next to the swimming pool.
words.tipFa: court برای تنیس، بسکتبال، والیبال و بدمینتون. برای فوتبال pitch.

words.example: The players are walking onto the football pitch.
Our hotel has an outdoor swimming pool.
The new sports centre has a gym and a pool.
What's your favourite sport? Volleyball.

gapQuestions.sentence: In winter we go ___ in the mountains near Tehran.
gapQuestions.hintFa: روی برف، با دو تا چوب.

gapQuestions.sentence: You play ___ on a big table with small bats and a light ball.
___ is a Japanese sport where you try to throw the other person to the floor.
gapQuestions.hintFa: ورزش رزمی با پرت کردن حریف.

gapQuestions.sentence: Basketball is played on a ___, not on a pitch.
Football and rugby are played on a ___.
We go ___ on the Caspian Sea in a small boat with a white sail.
In ___, players hit a ball with a bat and run around four bases.
Our town has a new ___ with a gym, a pool and tennis courts.
You need a racket and a shuttlecock for ___.
I go ___ every morning in the park: five kilometres.
